digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py each exceed the 800 LOC module-size cap after Gerrit 1796, blocking further edits until decomposed

completion.py holds four distinct concerns (operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-close bug-screen, verdict reconciliation) that must be separated into modules with clear contractual boundaries
completion_recovery.py holds three concerns (criteria surface and admission bounds, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) requiring separation into distinct modules
all moved symbols must remain patchable and accessible via stable re-export facades so existing callers, tests, and monkeypatch targets stay valid unchanged
final decomposition targets modules in the 200-500 LOC range with zero behavior changes and zero assertion modifications to tests
